variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by the union {name}.
variants.body:
The union {name} has called a strike. The call establishes a labour action, not an account of its participation or outcome. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the decision to call a strike from unreported claims about wages, conditions or the response of an employer.

A union has called a strike. That is the news, before somebody supplies a deserted factory, a furious owner or a perfect speech on a picket line. Working people and employers can be judged without that scenery. Keep the attention on the call and the responsibilities it raises.

The conduct of {target} should be examined against the strike call itself. This paper does not assign unreported demands or assume the participation and outcome of the labour action announced here. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.sub: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action.
variants.body:
A strike has been called by the union {name}. The event places the relationship between work and bargaining in public view. For {target}, responsibility should be judged without supplying a demand, a workplace closure or an agreement that this report does not establish.
